Lookup.title: Find your booking
Lookup.intro: Enter your booking code and the email address you booked with. We will send that address a single-use link to open the booking.
Lookup.codeHint: For example PTA-2611-0042, in your confirmation email.
Lookup.sent: If those details match a booking, we have just emailed a link to that address. It works once, for a short time.
Lookup.unavailable: Booking lookup is not available right now. Please contact us by email or phone.
Lookup.account: Have an account? Sign in to see all your bookings.
